blocks.text: What does an affordable condominium in Cavite share with a sail-shaped beachfront tower in Batangas? On paper, very little. One is aimed at buyers taking an early step onto the property ladder; the other promises a premium coastal lifestyle. Between those points are suburban communities in Luzon, high-rise homes in Cebu and Davao, a nature-led estate in Quezon City, and a branded condotel on Samal Island. Yet the same test recurs across the residential and design winners at the 14th PropertyGuru Philippines Property Awards: how convincingly architecture, landscape, location, and shared space work together once people arrive.
